entries.title: See where a task stands at a glance
entries.body: A crewmate now reports its plan as a short list of what the task takes, each item done, current, next or skipped. The summary that opens when you rest on a task shows it as dots on a line with a short label under each, and the task's record shows the whole list under its facts, with the time each finished item finished. Long lists fold their finished items away.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.
